gen-fs-bevellier-gf-hind-mysuru: Bevellier cuts flat, stencil-style letters from a single stroke weight, packed tight, while Hind Mysuru lets lowercase press up to ascender height. Give the heading plenty of size and the body modest room.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-hind-siliguri: Hind Siliguri hums along in a flat gray texture of constant line weight. Bevellier excels at stencil-cut display with tight spacing, while Hind Siliguri excels at steady reading, its rounds gapped like a cracked bangle.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-hind-vadodara: Big open-looking e and a with tall bowls make the body text spacious and clear. Hind Vadodara sits beneath the flat, stencil-cut Bevellier and gives its tightly spaced letters room to breathe.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-huninn: Huninn keeps its s terminals clear of the body, with lowercase rising close to cap height. Huninn over a full page of text feels sturdy, with fat crossbars matching the stems, while Bevellier stays flat up top.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-inter-tight: Flat, cut-stencil swagger up top: Bevellier packs tight single-weight letters, and Inter Tight tucks short ascenders below. Bevellier makes the bold statement; Inter Tight carries the words along quietly.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-karla: Wirelike, stencil-cut strokes of one thickness: that is Bevellier, tightly spaced and graceful. Karla does the opposite job best, with a gaping c opening and a middle band so tall the line looks stocky.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-kedebideri: Flat, unvarying stencil-cut strokes make Bevellier unmistakable. Kedebideri brings rounded, open letters beneath a skyward x-height; that mix of graceful and inviting, stencil-cut and soft, is the pair's real draw.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-khula: Curves that hold their mouths open sit on a tall midsection, like a squat brush-pen belly. Khula leaves the flat, unvarying line of Bevellier to do the talking, and that split is the pair's best quality.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-krub: Krub stands tall on a pronounced x-height, its pen-lifted curves leaving each loop unfinished. And Bevellier, smooth as drawn wire throughout, supplies the graceful, stencil-cut contrast that defines this pairing.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-kufam: Kufam runs one track width throughout, like a neon sign tube. Its bodies dominate the line and ascenders hardly show, so extended text flows smoothly under the tight, flat letters of Bevellier.
